about: Requests whose job is known: the parts of tests/live_orchestrator.py's requests as the real Qwen3.5 9B model and plain code rightly handled them on 2026-11-18 (reviewed by hand; the wrong ones left out or corrected), and the words of tests/test_help.py for every job. tests/test_eval_patterns.py checks that the planner's patterns keep naming their jobs. Never take a request from the evaluation sets: they measure words VisionClaw was never tuned on.
